resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (Occupancy Permit, Change of Ownership) or Transfer of Ownership Permit
resale_co.lead_time: All applications take 7 to 10 business days for processing and inspection dates.
requirements: Fire safety certificate (smoke alarms, CO alarms) from the Pleasantville Fire Department
Heat and hot water heater certificate from a licensed plumber or HVAC technician (electric units do not need one)
Fireplace certification if there is one: gas units by an HVAC technician or plumber, wood burning fireplaces by a licensed chimney sweep
All utilities on at the time of inspection

Home fit for habitation under the City Property Maintenance Code: no fire or accident hazards, adequate ventilation, light and sanitary facilities, no dilapidation, disrepair, structural defects or uncleanliness
Buyers using an LLC must give the owner's or property caregiver's name and contact information

fees.label: Residential application (Occupancy Permit or Transfer of Ownership Permit), non-refundable
fees.quote: For residential properties, a non-refundable fee of sixty dollars ($60.00) must be paid when application is submitted.

fees.label: Re-inspection, each
fees.quote: If a re-inspection is required to bring the unit into compliance a fifty dollar ($50.00) fee will be charged, and/or any additional inspections thereafter.

fees.label: Late cancellation (after 4:00 pm the day before)
fees.quote: Should you find it necessary to cancel an appointment, you must do so by 4:00 pm on the day prior to said appointment, or a fifty dollar ($50.00) fee shall be charged.

fees.label: Inspection aborted because utilities are off
fees.quote: All utilities MUST BE ON at time of inspection or the inspection shall be aborted and a $50 fee shall be required for re-inspection.

fees.label: Reprint after a name change within 5 days of printing
fees.quote: Should the current owner, new owners, tenant name, or name on application change within 5 days from when the Occupancy permit was printed, a new occupancy permit will be printed at an additional cost of $2.00

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Certificate of Occupancy packet from the City Forms page and complete the 'Occupancy Permit/Transfer of Ownership Permit' application (check 'Occupancy Permit - Change of Ownership', or 'Transfer of Ownership Permit' if the buyer will fix violations). Submit it to Code Enforcement (City Hall Annex, 132 West Washington Avenue; mailing address 18 N. First Street) with the $60 fee by check or money order payable to City of Pleasantville (no cash), plus the fire safety and heat/hot water certificates. A Transfer of Ownership Permit needs a signed, notarized statement from the new owner and does not allow occupancy. Inspectors take scheduling calls from 8:30 to 9:30 am and 4:00 to 4:30 pm.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction/Zoning Official (Code Enforcement / Housing Division phone listed)

evidence.quote: The City of Pleasantville requires a Certificate of Occupancy and a Yearly Rental Registration Certificate prior to occupancy of any rental property or sale of property.
evidence.doc_date: 2023-11 (instruction page revised 11/03/23; application pages updated 10/03/2022; scanned, read visually)

evidence.quote: TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP PERMIT - A permit issued by the Code Enforcement Officer or designee for the exclusive and sole purpose of Changing Ownership of a dwelling unit or property.
All applications require 7 - 10 business days for processing and inspection dates.
Fire/Carbon Monoxide/Fire Extinguisher Certifications are required anytime a Certificate of Occupancy is obtained. That is whenever a residential dwelling is being rented or sold.

resale_co.notes: The City's Certificate of Occupancy packet (instruction page revised 11/03/23) says a Certificate of Occupancy is required before occupancy after any sale. Two paths exist: an Occupancy Permit for a change of ownership, or a Transfer of Ownership Permit, where the new owner signs a notarized statement taking responsibility for code violations; that permit does not allow occupancy. If no certificate or permit is issued within 3 months of the application, the application becomes void. The application pages (updated 10/03/2022) name Kevin Cain as Construction Code Official; the City's current officials page names Ben Silkowitz as Construction/Zoning Official ((609) 677-4802), so he is listed, with the Code Enforcement / Housing Division number 609-484-3633 from the packet and the Building and Zoning page. City staff emails are hidden behind Cloudflare email protection and were not recorded. Lead-safe certification and insurance apply to rentals only; yearly rental registration is a separate program.

requirements: Homes built before April 4, 1991: smoke alarm on each level including the basement (not attic or crawl space) and near each separate sleeping area
Homes built after April 4, 1991: smoke alarm on each level and in each bedroom, 110-volt interconnected with battery backup
Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed (hardwired alarms excluded)
Carbon monoxide alarms in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas

Portable fire extinguisher: the 2025 application says it is required for multi-family properties only (excluding one- and two-family homes), 2.5 to 10 lb ABC dry chemical, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen. The Fire Department web page still says extinguishers are required in 1, 2 and 3 family dwellings.

authorities.name: Pleasantville Fire Department, Office of Fire Prevention (Fire Prevention Bureau)
authorities.lead_time: Inspections are on Mondays and Wednesdays; the expedited fee gets a same or next business day inspection. Cancel at least 48 hours before the inspection.

fees.label: Expedited, same or next business day
fees.quote: Expedited Fee: $160 (same or next business day)

fees.label: Duplicate certificate, each
fees.quote: Any additional gold certificates of inspections duplicates will be a $10.00 fee for each.

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the Application for Certification of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide Detector, Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance (check 'Sale') and bring it to the Office of Fire Prevention inside the Fire Department, 1 N. First Street (1st Street side door), 8:30 am to 4:30 pm on weekdays. Pay by check or money order payable to the City of Pleasantville; fees are non-refundable and mail-ins are not accepted.

evidence.quote: Inspections are conducted on Monday's & Wednesday's
*Portable Fire Extinguisher (MUST BE) 2 ½ to 10 lbs. ABC dry chemical within 10 ft. of the kitchen. *REQUIRED FOR MULTI-FAMILY PROPERTIES ONLY*
The fee required is $60. Certifications requested within 24 hrs. require a $160 fee.
Fire extinguishers are required in 1, 2 and 3 family dwellings only.
LEAID: 0119-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Anton Brown Phone (609) 484-3670

fire_cert.notes: The Pleasantville Fire Department is the local fire code enforcing agency (LEA code F). Its web page and 2025 application give the same fees ($60, $160 expedited). Phone numbers differ by source: the 2025 form gives OFFICE 609-569-2042 (used here), the Fire Department page lists the Fire Bureau at (609) 484-3625, and the City's CO packet and the state directory give 609-484-3670. The form also prints a cell number, which is not recorded. The state directory lists Abrown@pleasantvillefd.net for Anton Brown; the form's office email prevention@pleasantvillefd.net is used. The 2025 form's heading excludes one- and two-family homes from the extinguisher requirement, matching the 2025 state law change, while the web page text still lists 1, 2 and 3 family dwellings.

other_items.label: Heat and hot water heater certificate
other_items.detail: From any licensed plumber or HVAC technician; electric units do not need certification.

other_items.label: Fireplace certification
other_items.detail: If there is a fireplace: gas units by an HVAC technician or plumber, wood burning fireplaces by a licensed chimney sweep.

other_items.label: Utilities on
other_items.detail: All utilities must be on at inspection or the inspection is aborted and a $50 re-inspection fee applies.

open_questions: How long the Certificate of Occupancy stays valid after issue is not stated.
